Eurōpa, Eurōpae f.

noun, first declension

A continent takes a preposition: in Eurōpam, in Eurōpā, ex Eurōpā.

Other words

  • Eurōpaeus, Eurōpaea, Eurōpaeum — European

    declension · also used · classical · Nep. Eum. 3: adversāriī (Lewis & Short s.v. Eurōpa); Traupman 204

Examples

  • Tōta Eurōpa inter nōs et avum jacet.

    All of Europe lies between us and Grandpa.Libellus I, Iter in Lūsitāniam

See also Italy, Spain, France, Poland, Alps, Germany, Britain, Russia, Scandinavia, the Balkans.
